title: Buffer Service State
description: Accumulates pipeline values into an array and flushes them as a batch when a capacity or time threshold is reached. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/buffer)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

capacity.description: Maximum number of items before an automatic flush

interval.description: Flush interval in milliseconds. -1 disables timer-based flushing

accumulatedOutput.description: When true, each flush emits the full accumulated buffer since the last clear rather than just the current window
